basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old from San Francisco, deeply passionate about horology and spend my days working as a graphic designer. I often find myself browsing Reddit during late evenings, especially after work. I have a penchant for collecting vintage watches, and I share my insights and opinions on various watch-related subreddits. Although single, I enjoy the company of my close circle of friends who share my interests. Besides watches, I have a growing interest in the gaming world, particularly strategy games like League of Legends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My expertise lies in graphic design, a skill honed through a combination of formal education in art and a decade of practical experience. My interest in horology is self-taught, fueled by countless hours of reading articles, watching documentaries, and participating in online forums. My knowledge of gaming is more casual, mainly developed through personal play and community engagement.
